name: JK Lakshmi Cement Limited
remarksWeb: Consequent to dissolution of Bharat Hari Singhania (HUF) [with PAN - AABHB8298J, one of the constituent of the Promoter Group] 300 Equity Shares held by the said HUF in JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd. were transferred to Coparcener of the HUF, Shri Bharat Hari Singhania [PAN - AJWPS3245G, one of the constituent of the Promoter Group] by inter-se transfer through off market trade on 22nd March 2023, without any consideration. Accordingly, the shareholding of Shri Bharat Hari Singhania increased to 2,06,848 from 2,06,548 and the total number of Promoter & Promoter Group decreased to 22 from 23.
